display-titanic.purpose: Single-screen ledger numerals (e.g., points-store totals). Use rarely.

display-hero.purpose: The SparkleHero accent numeral. Post-class scaffold only.

display-medium.purpose: Secondary display numerals (rank tier, large stat counters).

headline.purpose: Screen titles and section H1s. Tracks at -0.02em.

title.purpose: Section headers, list-row primaries (class name, gym name).

title-soft.purpose: Title-weight text for body-density use (long instructor names, descriptions).

body-large.purpose: Long-form copy: class descriptions, instructor bios.

body.purpose: Default in-app paragraph and metadata size.

eyebrow.purpose: Small-caps labels above and below SparkleHero accent. Reserved for that pattern.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for state transitions. Duration <=300ms. No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a screen. Cage Orange fill, no shadow, 16px rounded.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF6C2D; color: #F4F3EE; font-family: Jura, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF7E45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3EE; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(255, 108, 45, 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary or non-committal action. Pill-shaped (1000px), 2px Bone border, transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #F4F3EE; font-family: Jura, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 8px 16px; border: 2px solid #F4F3EE; border-radius: 1000px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(244, 243, 238, 0.08); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6C2D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Timeframe Pill
components.description: Time-range selector (1W / 1M / 1Y). Active variant has a 2px Bone border; rest variant has no border and Bone Mute label.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { height: 30px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: rgba(244, 243, 238, 0.5); font-family: Jura, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; border: none; border-radius: 32px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-pill--active { color: #F4F3EE; border: 2px solid #F4F3EE; } .ds-pill:hover { color: #F4F3EE; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6C2D; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: CombatDen is a points-and-streaks ledger that occasionally erupts into broadcast celebration. Most surfaces are calm columns of progress: class lists, rank deltas, points balances, video shelves. Then, exactly at the moments a member earns something on the mat, the ledger goes loud. Calm by default, kinetic when attendance pays off. The canvas is the gym after dark: near-black, warm bone-white text, sharp Material Symbols at light weight, Jura sans across every size. There is no marketing aesthetic, no wellness softness, no consumer-fitness gamification. The member is treated as a practitioner; the design treats their time the same way. Density beats whitespace; legibility beats decoration; rationed celebration beats constant cheerleading. This system explicitly rejects the look-and-feel of generic fitness SaaS (MyFitnessPal, Fitbod). It also rejects the gym-CRM-admin density of Mindbody / ClassPass / Triib; CombatDen sits next to those tools but is the member-facing layer, not another console.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas; cage-orange agency color used on <=10% of any screen.
Jura sans across the entire scale, from 11px caption to 160px display.
No shadows. Depth comes from a 10%-bone tonal layer over the canvas.
Rounded rectangles (16 / 32) for surfaces; full pills (1000) for outline buttons and tag selectors.
Sharp Material Symbols, weight 300, T-shirt sized 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36.
Coach-to-athlete copy: imperative, factual, uppercase only on display eyebrows.
Celebration is rationed to the post-class scaffold; everywhere else is quiet.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cage Orange covers <=10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point. The instant orange becomes a background fill, a divider color, or a chart axis, the agency signal collapses. If a screen needs warmth without spending agency, use Ember Deep.

rules.name: The Single Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one card surface (Surface Card, 10% bone over canvas). Nested cards are forbidden. If hierarchy is needed inside a card, use type weight, eyebrows, and dividers, never a second tonal layer.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Canvas Black is not #000 and Bone Text is not #fff. Both are tinted toward warm. Pure black or pure white inside a CombatDen surface is a bug.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: The entire system runs on Jura. Pairing Jura with a serif, a script, or a different sans is forbidden. Hierarchy is built from weight and scale, not from font-family contrast.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Headline Rule
rules.body: The 24px Headline runs at -0.02em letter-spacing. The 11px Eyebrow runs at +0.24em (true small-cap treatment). Track for the size; never letter-space body or subtitle copy beyond their token defaults.

rules.name: The Tap-Readable Rule
rules.body: The 11px Caption is for non-actionable metadata only. If a member must read a string to decide or act on it, the floor is 12px Body. Members range from teenagers to adults in their 50s, often reading in variable gym lighting.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. There is no shadow vocabulary. State changes communicate through color and border, not through elevation.

rules.name: The No-Glassmorphism Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter, no blurred translucent panels, no glass card decoration. The 10%-bone Surface Card is the only allowed translucent surface, and it is not blurred.

rules.name: The Single Primary Rule
rules.body: A screen has exactly one Primary button. If the design seems to want two, one of them becomes an Outline.

rules.name: The SparkleHero Rationing Rule
rules.body: SparkleHero appears only inside the post-class scaffold flow. Never on home, booking, profile, stats, video, or rewards landing. Putting it elsewhere debases the celebration.

rules.name: The Sharp Icon Rule
rules.body: Every icon is Symbols.<name>_sharp at weight 300. Filled, rounded, or outlined Material variants are forbidden; non-Material icon sets are forbidden.

dos: Do keep Cage Orange (#FF6C2D) on <=10% of any screen. Reserve it for primary actions, the active metric, and SparkleHero particles.
Do layer with the Surface Card token (#F4F3EE1A, 10% bone over Canvas Black). It's the only tonal step the system has.
Do use Jura for every text size. Build hierarchy from weight (400 / 600 / 700) and scale (11 -> 160), not from family contrast.
Do use Symbols.<name>_sharp from material_symbols_icons, weight 300, sized off the T-shirt scale (16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36).
Do keep SparkleHero inside the post-class scaffold. It's the system's one loud moment; protect its rarity.
Do treat the member like a practitioner. Coach-to-athlete copy: imperative, factual, outcome-named. 'Reserve your spot', not 'Get yours before they're gone!'
Do keep pSmall (11px Caption) for non-actionable metadata only. If a member must read a label to act, the floor is 12px Body.
Do use radius 16 for tight surfaces and radius 32 for screen-section cards. Use the full pill (1000) for outline buttons and timeframe pills.
donts: Don't use #000 or #fff. Canvas Black is #121619, Bone Text is #F4F3EE. Pure black or pure white inside CombatDen is a bug.

Don't ship gradient fills, gradient text, or background-clip: text. The system has none, and the hero-metric template (big number + tiny label + supporting stats + gradient accent) is explicitly forbidden.
Don't ship glassmorphism: no backdrop-filter, no blurred translucent panels, no glass cards. The single tonal layer (Surface Card at 10% bone) is not blurred.
Don't ship box-shadow. Buttons render at elevation: 0. The bottom nav uses a 1px Bone Mute hairline, not a shadow.
Don't ship side-stripe borders: no border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
Don't nest cards. There is exactly one card surface. If hierarchy is needed inside, use type weight and dividers, not a second tonal layer.
Don't introduce a second font. Jura runs the entire scale, top to bottom.
Don't ship the look-and-feel of generic fitness SaaS (MyFitnessPal, Fitbod, Strava-for-everyone). No teal/lime pastel accents, no cartoon mascots, no badges-as-stickers, no 'Crush your goal!' copy.
Don't ship the wellness / mindfulness aesthetic (soft gradients, pastel everything, rounded blobs, 'self-care' copy). Wrong sport, wrong audience.
Don't ship em dashes. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses. Also not '--'.
Don't SparkleHero outside the post-class scaffold. Putting it on home, booking, profile, stats, videos, or rewards-landing collapses its rarity.
Don't invent a third button shape. The system has Primary (filled rectangle, 16r) and Outline (pill, 1000r). A third level is a styled link in Bone Soft.
Don't pull motion energy beyond <=300ms ease-out on state changes. No bounce, no elastic, no spring.
